decisionsTitle: Checkpoints and cut-off times on the route: the editor, the event page and the bib's profile
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-13:** «other things for the route: I need to put checkpoints and limit times»; on the race number: «nu pot să văd unde e punctul de alimentare pe acel număr»; and on the event's duration box («Ore / Minute», «Cât durează — de exemplu 1 oră și 45 de minute…»): «Aici nu e clar „cât durează” ce? trebuie să pot pune timp limită». Amends §718 (the route) and §750 (the bib's profile strip), and §71/§433 (the duration box).

**Decision — the data.** A table of its own, `event_checkpoints` (migration `0147`, expand only): the event (deleted with it), a position, a name in Romanian and in English (both required, 60 characters each), the kilometre (`numeric(6,2)`, never negative, never beyond the route's length — the distance the club typed, else the GPX's), what is there as a closed set (`event_checkpoint_kind[]`: «Apă», «Mâncare», «Prim ajutor», «Cronometrare»; a fifth is a migration, like every state here), an optional cut-off and an optional note in both languages or neither (120 characters each). The list is read by kilometre; the position only keeps two points at the same kilometre in the order they were typed.

**The cut-off is a time of the day on the event's own clock** (`time`, in `events.timezone`), not a `timestamptz`. An instant is the right answer on the day it is typed and the wrong one the day the club moves the race: the start, the programme and the end follow the new date while a stored instant stays on the old one, and every cut-off would have to be shifted by hand. A time of the day follows the date by construction. It is counted from the race's gun when it has one, else the event's start; a cut-off at or before that start is refused, one after a farther point's cut-off is refused (a runner passes kilometre 10 before kilometre 20), and one after the end is refused. A race that ends on the next day reads a cut-off earlier than the gun's time as the next day's; any other event refuses it.

**The editor.** «Puncte de control», «Traseul»'s second card (a link in «Traseul» opens it): add (three spare rows), change, remove («Scoate»), always shown by kilometre; the house's form primitives, 44-pixel targets, a glyph before every button's words, plain forms that work with scripts off. **The card's forms are its own, beside the editor's save form and not in it**: HTML forms cannot nest, and a refusal here — a kilometre beyond the route, said with the route's length; a cut-off before the start or after a farther point's — must keep what was typed here and nothing of the event's other boxes (the shape of §749's card). A save never deletes a point it was not told about (a colleague's point added meanwhile survives). The Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator write; every other role that opens the editor reads the list as words; the role is asserted on the server and every change writes one audit row `event_checkpoints.changed` (the list before and after: kilometre, name, cut-off — the club's own work, never a participant). «Ia punctele din GPX» appears when the uploaded GPX has `<wpt>` waypoints: each is projected on the nearest stretch of the track to give its kilometre along it, its kinds guessed from its name, symbol and type; a waypoint farther than 300 m from the track is left out and counted; the preview lists them ticked, and «Adaugă punctele alese» adds the ticked ones, never twice.

**«Timp limită».** The duration box keeps its column and its two boxes; its words follow the type select, with a stopwatch before them: a race asks «Timp limită» («Cât au alergătorii de la start până se închide sosirea — de exemplu 2 ore și 30 de minute. Lasă gol dacă nu există.»), every other event «Cât durează evenimentul» («De la start până la final — de exemplu 1 oră și 45 de minute. Sfârșitul se calculează singur. Lasă gol dacă nu s-a anunțat.»). **For a race the minutes count from the gun when it has one** (`duration.ts#durationBase`), so the stored end is the moment the finish closes; the editor, its summary, the night line and the event's file read the box back from the same instant, so a save that changes nothing keeps the end. A race saved before this whose gun is after its meeting time keeps its end; its box now reads the minutes from the gun. Every other event keeps its end exactly as before.

**The event page.** «Timp limită: 2 h 30 min» under «Când» on a race. Under the route's maps, the table «Puncte de control» / «Checkpoints»: the kilometre, the point (its note under it), what is there — a chip with the glyph **and** the word, never the glyph alone — and «Ora limită 11:30»; the last row is the finish, «Sosire · se închide la 12:30», on a race with a time limit only (another event's end is when it ends, no limit). Nothing is drawn without checkpoints. At 320 pixels each row is a block, each cell with its column's word. The card's saves expire the public cache's `events` tag, as the editor's do.

**The bib's profile strip.** «Punctele de control pe profil» (on by default; drawn only with the profile and the event's checkpoints): at each kilometre an aid station is a small drawn glyph — a cup where there is water, a fork where there is food alone — above the line, or under it where the line runs too high, never out of the profile's own row, so never over the number or the name; any other point is a dot; each has a thin tick to the chart's foot and «km 12» under it where there is room. «…cu timpii limită» (off by default: a time printed on paper cannot be corrected) prints «km 12 · 11:30». **The crowding rule**: a mark closer than 6 points to the one before gives way, to an aid station first; the times are printed only when every label then fits — all or none, since a number that says some cut-offs is read as the others having none; without them each «km» is printed where it clears its neighbour and the words «Start» and «Sosire»; the marks always stay. One geometry decides it for the PDF and the picture; the pictures' addresses — the bibs page's, the designer's preview (`v=`) and the desk's SQL stamp — cover the checkpoints' kilometres, kinds and cut-offs and the two ticks, so no stale picture is served. The bib's header is not touched.

**The event's JSON file (§751)** carries `route.checkpoints` (kilometre, both names, kinds, cut-off, note; no id) and the two ticks. Export reads them; an import as new writes them after the event exists; an import over writes the file's list where the diff shows it changed (the diff names it «Punctele de control»). Both hold the list to the card's rules against the file's event before anything is copied or written, so a list the card would refuse refuses the whole file. A file made before checkpoints existed reads with none.

**Not changed:** registrations, the capacity, the emails.

**Refused:** a `timestamptz` cut-off (it drifts when the date moves, above); free-text kinds (a word the page and the bib cannot draw a glyph for); the card's boxes inside the editor's save form (a refusal there would lose the event's other boxes, and forms cannot nest); some cut-offs on a crowded bib and not others; counting a race's limit from the meeting time (the help says «de la start», and a runner's start is the gun).
changelogLine: - **Checkpoints and the race's «Timp limită»** — «Puncte de control» in «Traseul» (water, food, first aid, timing, a cut-off; from the GPX's waypoints in one press), a table on the event page with the finish closing time, «Timp limită: 2 h 30 min» for a race, and the aid stations marked on the bib's profile strip with «km 12» and, ticked, the cut-offs. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event with checkpoints, when its page renders, then under the route's maps the table «Puncte de control» / «Checkpoints» lists them by kilometre with the point's name and note in the page's language, what is there as chips each with its glyph and its word, and «Ora limită 11:30» or a dash read as «fără oră limită»; a race with a time limit ends the table with «Sosire» «se închide la 12:30» at the event's end on its own clock, any other event has no finish row, an event without checkpoints has no section, and at 320 pixels each row is a block whose cells carry their column's word (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a race with a time limit, when its page renders, then «Timp limită» / «Time limit» says the minutes from the gun (else the start) to the end as «2 h 30 min» under «Când», with a stopwatch; no other type has the row (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the event editor, when an Organizer, an Administrator or a Superadministrator saves «Puncte de control», then a name in both languages, a kilometre from 0 within the route's length (the typed distance, else the GPX's), kinds from «Apă», «Mâncare», «Prim ajutor», «Cronometrare», a cut-off as a time of the day after the start (the gun's on a race), not after the end and not after a farther point's, and a note in both languages or neither are kept, by kilometre; anything else is refused naming the box with the reason (a kilometre beyond the route says the route's length) and keeps what was typed; a point not on the form is never deleted; every change is audited as `event_checkpoints.changed`; any other role reads the list and its save is refused FORBIDDEN on the server (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event whose uploaded GPX has `<wpt>` waypoints, when «Ia punctele din GPX» is pressed, then a preview lists each waypoint within 300 m of the track with its kilometre along the track (the waypoint projected on the nearest stretch) and kinds guessed from its words, ticked, and says how many were farther; «Adaugă punctele alese» adds the ticked ones through the same rules, never one already listed at the same kilometre with the same name, and a GPX replaced since the preview is a CONFLICT (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The duration box is labelled by the type select with a glyph — «Timp limită» with «Cât au alergătorii de la start până se închide sosirea — de exemplu 2 ore și 30 de minute. Lasă gol dacă nu există.» on a race, «Cât durează evenimentul» with «De la start până la final — de exemplu 1 oră și 45 de minute. Sfârșitul se calculează singur. Lasă gol dacă nu s-a anunțat.» otherwise, in both languages — and a race's minutes count from its gun when it has one: the stored end is the gun plus the minutes, the editor, its summary and the event's file read the box back from the gun, and every other event's end is the start plus the minutes as before (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

An event's JSON file carries `route.checkpoints` (kilometre, both names, kinds, cut-off, note; no id) and the bib's two checkpoint ticks; an import as new writes the list, an import over writes it where the diff shows «Punctele de control» changed, a list the editor's card would refuse refuses the whole import before anything is written, an export–import–export round trip gives the same list, and a file without the key reads and imports with none (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Profilul traseului» and «Punctele de control pe profil» ticked (the second on by default) and an event with checkpoints, every number — sheet, picture and preview — marks each checkpoint within the printed distance on the profile strip: a drawn cup where there is water, a fork where there is food alone, a dot otherwise, a tick to the chart's foot, «km 12» under it where it clears its neighbours and «Start»/«Sosire»; with «…cu timpii limită» (off by default) «km 12 · 11:30» only when every label then fits, else no time at all; a mark within 6 points of the one before gives way, to an aid station first; nothing is drawn outside the profile's row; the bibs page's, the preview's and the desk's picture addresses change when a checkpoint's kilometre, kinds or cut-off or either tick changes (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: route checkpoints, cut-offs and the race's time limit
